newsitem.title: ZAIRE: DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF CONGO - Kabila government bans Kinshasa demonstrations.
newsitem.headline: DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC OF CONGO - Kabila government bans Kinshasa demonstrations.

text.p: Self-proclaimed president Laurent Kabila's government banned all public demonstrations in the capital Kinshasa until further notice, citing a need to maintain security, state television reported on Monday.

At the same time the administration, formed after Kabila's forces drove veteran dictator Mobutu Sese Seko from power earlier this month, banned all activities of political parties in the city until further notice.
The television, quoting a communique issued by "the higher national institutions", also said that no unit of Kabila's armed forces would be allowed to circulate in the city without specific orders.

"Individual or collective public demonstrations are formally prohibited throughout the city of Kinshasa until further notice," it said. "All the activities of the political parties are banned in Kinshasa until further notice."
Supporters of veteran opposition leader Etienne Tshisekedi said at the weekend that they would stage protest marches against Kabila and his government on Wednesday and Friday.
